name: Void Cultivator (Geomancer Archetype)
body:
While most geomancers draw powers from the five elements, some seek the element that binds them all, Void. These geomancers are called void cultivators.

Profound Communion

At 1st level, whenever a void cultivator communes with the spirits to prepare their daily geomancer spells, they can attune to the Void element in addition to another element (Earth, Fire, Metal, Water, or Wood) that they choose to attune to normally that day.

Void Element: Any spell with void in its name, the void descriptor, or those specifically mentioned in the Void Element Spells sidebar on page 10.

A void cultivator must select one of the corresponding counteracting elements to their chosen attuned element (see below):

Earth: counteracted by Metal and Water.
Fire: counteracted by Earth and Metal.
Metal: counteracted by Water and Wood.
Water: counteracted by Fire and Wood.
Wood: counteracted by Fire and Earth.

A void cultivator cannot cast any spell or spell-like ability of the selected counteracting element (including via magic items), even if the spell also belongs to the Void element, and they suffer a -2 penalty on all of their saves against effects belonging to the selected counteracting element.

A void cultivator may select a different counteracting element each time they commune with the spirits to prepare their daily geomancer spells.

This ability alters spells.

Diminished Spellcasting

A void cultivator casts one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, they may only cast spells of that level if their Wisdom score provides bonus spells of that level.

This alters spells.

The following two abilities, ki pool and way of void, replace guardian spirits.

Ki Pool (Su)

At 1st level, a void cultivator gains an internal reservoir of ki points that can be used as described below. Once per day, when a void cultivator communes with the spirits to prepare their spells, their ki pool is replenished to full. A void cultivator’s ki pool can hold a number of void points up to their Wisdom modifier.

A void cultivator can replenish a maximum of 1 ki point during any round into their ki pool through any one of the following ways:

Aura of Heavenly Blessing: Whenever an opponent within 30 feet rolls a natural 1 on any attack roll they make against the void cultivator’s AC.
Aura of Earthly Misfortunes: Whenever an opponent within 30 feet rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw. This applies only against the void cultivator’s feats or their abilities (including spells) derived from the void cultivator class.

Feats or other effects (including spells and magic items) that force the die roll of an opponent’s attack roll or saving throw to instead be a natural 1 does not qualify.

A void cultivator stacks their geomancer levels with another class that provides a ki pool to determine the total number of ki points they possess in their combined ki pool. However, only one ability score modifier is added to the combined ki pool; this choice, once made, is permanently set. A void cultivator now uses ki points from this combined ki pool to power the abilities of any class ability they possess that requires ki points.

Way of the Void

Once per round for each effect below, a void cultivator may expend 1 ki point from their ki pool to achieve one of the following effects they qualify for:

Heavenly Assistance, Earthly Effort (Ex)

Starting at 1st level, as a free action, a void cultivator can re-roll any one skill check or d20 roll they made on an attempt to use the Aid Another action to assist another creature.

They gain a +1 bonus on this re-roll; this bonus increases by +1 every 3 void cultivator levels thereafter thereafter.

Void Insight (Su)

Starting at 2nd level, as a free action, a void cultivator can gain an additional +1 bonus to a single caster level check or concentration check they make. This bonus increases by +1 every 3 void cultivator levels thereafter.

Yin-Yang Harmony (Su)

Starting at 3rd level, as a move action, a void cultivator can call upon the energies of heaven and earth to heal themselves. They heal an amount of damage equal to their Wisdom modifier + 1.

This amount increases by +1 every 3 void cultivator levels thereafter.

Heavenly Way (Su)

Starting at 2nd level, whenever a void cultivator uses rebuke spirits to damage spirit creatures in the vicinity, instead of damaging spirits based on their chosen attuned element, they can instead damage the following spirits due to their affinity with the Void element.

Void Element

Any outsider, fey, or incorporeal undead with an alignment subtype (chaotic, evil, good, or lawful) of the void cultivator’s choosing. A void cultivator must choose which alignment subtype each time they use rebuke spirits to damage spirits in this way. However, when using rebuke spirits to damage spirits in this way, a void cultivator uses d4s instead of d6s to determine the amount of damage dealt by rebuke spirits.

This ability alters rebuke spirits.
